33enum operating_mode {
34 PPM_OPMODE_NONE = 0b00,
35 PPM_OPMODE_AGENT_ONLY = 0b01,
36 PPM_OPMODE_CONTROLLER_ONLY = 0b10,
37 PPM_OPMODE_AGENT_AND_CONTROLLER = PPM_OPMODE_AGENT_ONLY | PPM_OPMODE_CONTROLLER_ONLY,
38};
39
40inline std::string to_string(operating_mode mode)
41{
42 switch (mode) {
43 default:
44 case PPM_OPMODE_NONE:
45 return "Not operational";
46 case PPM_OPMODE_AGENT_ONLY:
47 return "Agent only";
48 case PPM_OPMODE_CONTROLLER_ONLY:
49 return "Controller only";
50 case PPM_OPMODE_AGENT_AND_CONTROLLER:
51 return "Agent+Controller";
52 }
53}
